text:
emily: Heads-up: CI linkcheck is flagging broken fragment links after we switched to Docusaurus. Looks like fancy punctuation and invisible codepoints in headings are generating different slugs.
ben: saw it too. example CI lines: 
```
[linkcheck] WARNING: ./guides/cli.mdx: anchor not found: using-the-cli--examples
[linkcheck] WARNING: ./tutorials/auth.mdx: anchor not found: auth-keys-setup
```
rita: quick repro locally: headings containing U+00AD (soft hyphen), U+2026 (ellipsis), and ZWSP show up as different slugs in mkdocs vs docusaurus.
emily: i propose a conservative heading-only sanitizer step in the docs CI before linkcheck. strip zero-widths (U+200B..U+200D), U+FEFF, U+00AD; replace U+2026 with "..."; map curly quotes to straight, and collapse multiple spaces. keep body content as-is.
ben: sounds good. small perl one-liner would be easiest in CI. also add a unit test to docs-lint that slugifies a set of sample headings with both slugify implementations and asserts equality.
rita: perl example I'm putting in the PR description:
```bash
for f in $(git ls-files '*.md' '*.mdx'); do
  perl -C -pe "s/[\x{200B}-\x{200D}\x{FEFF}\x{00AD}]//g; s/\x{2026}/.../g; s/[\x{2018}\x{2019}]/'/g; s/[\x{201C}\x{201D}]/\"/g; s/\s{2,}/ /g;" -i "$f"
done
```
emily: please ensure the sanitizer only touches headings (lines starting with #) to avoid surprising content changes. add a dry-run flag and preserve line endings/file mode.
rita: added a small wrapper script `scripts/normalize_headings.sh` with `--dry-run` and `--apply` modes, plus a test vector. opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1624. ci-bot queued linkcheck + docs-lint.
ci-bot: CI started for PR #1624 (linkcheck, docs-lint, unit tests).
ben: reviewed; left a small comment to collapse spaces after removals. also asked for a short blurb in docs/migration.md describing the normalization policy so downstream automation knows what changed.
emily: once merged we should run a non-destructive backfill across main. infra prefers a single-signed maintenance commit for small char fixes. can infra run a dry-run first?
infra-bot: yes. running a dry-run backfill now and will report how many files would change.
ci-bot: PR updated: added heading-only guard and collapse-spaces fix.
infra-bot: dry-run backfill: 34 files would be modified. scheduling maintenance run T+1h to apply as single commit by infra-bot.
ci-bot: CI passed for PR #1624.
rita: merging.
infra-bot: maintenance backfill applied: 34 files modified, commit `docs: normalize heading punctuation and invisible chars to stabilize anchors` pushed by infra-bot.
emily: reran linkcheck on preview - fragment warnings cleared. great job everyone.
ben: added unit test to prevent regressions.
emily: closing thread once infra confirms there are no downstream regressions in the release pipeline. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
